_why: [R-ENF-02] ratchet for scripts/check_edition_date.py. Delivered valuation studies that did not carry their own edition date in their masthead when the check was adopted (03-Sep-2026). Each gets it at its next re-issue. MAY ONLY EVER SHORTEN (--prune).

_shortened.why: the 09-08-2026 edition was superseded by the 08-09-2026 re-issue and the document it named no longer exists. The new edition carries its edition date in the masthead in the two-date form this check's own docstring calls the better one — 'Edition of 8 September 2026 · anchored on the 7 September 2026 close' — with both dates DERIVED, the edition off the filename the document ships as and the anchor off the price it is struck on. A ratchet may only ever shorten and this is a shortening.
